body:
The development warning about inconsistent states warned about wrong information since #4249 for the `range*` widgets. This happened because we were checking for a `$$type` of `ais.range` while they're now `ais.rangeInput` and `ais.rangeSlider`.

Since there's a bit more logic now, I included the `places` widget in the test to make sure the warning also worked with widgets that don't use a connector.
title: fix(index): fix warning for widgets sharing connectors
